description.narrative: The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to strengthen the institutional capacity of SADC and participating countries to produce, disseminate and use quality statistics while increasing regional harmonization and collaboration.

The SADC Regional Statistics Project aims to strengthen the capacity of SADC and participating countries to produce, disseminate, and use high-quality, harmonized statistics. Supported by the SADC Secretariat, the project helps National Statistical Offices align national statistical systems with SADC standards under the SADC Protocol on Statistics. It covers Madagascar, Mozambique, Malawi, Zambia, Comoros, São Tome and Principe, and the SADC Secretariat. The project has three components: (i) improving the harmonization, quality, and dissemination of core social and economic statistics; (ii) closing country-level gaps in data production, statistical capacity, and data use; and (iii) supporting project management, oversight, and monitoring.

Madagascar Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I. A. 1. (b) (i) (A) The Recipient shall cause INSTAT to recruit, not laterthan one (1) month after the Effective Date, an accounting firm, responsible for carrying out financial management task related tothe Project

Madagascar Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I. A. 1. (b) (i) (C) The Recipient shall cause INSTAT to recruit, not laterthan six (6) months after the Effective Date, an external auditor

(b) (ii) The Recipient shall cause INSTAT to not later than three (3)months after the Effective Date, acquire, customize to the Project and install an accounting software; all with terms of reference,qualifications, experience and/or specifications acceptable to the Association

Madagascar Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I.A.1 (a): The Recipient shall cause INSTAT to establish and thereaftermaintain at all times during the implementation of the Project, a Project Implementation Unit within INSTAT with mandate,composition, and resources acceptable to the Association.

Malawi Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I.A.3: The Recipient shall, not later than three (3) months after the EffectiveDate, establish and thereafter maintain at all times during the implementation of the Project, a Project Steering Committeecomprised of the Commissioner of Statistics as the chair, and, inter alia, the following ministries, departments and agencies:agriculture, education, labor, health, national planning commission, department of economic planning and development, anddepartment of environmental affairs, all terms of reference and resources satisfactory to the Association, to be responsible for,inter alia, providing strategic and policy guidance on matters relating to the Project, all in accordance with the provisions ofthe Project Operational Manual.

Malawi Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I.B.1: The Recipient shall, not later than one hundred and twenty (120) days afterthe Signature Date, prepare and adopt, in accordance with terms of reference acceptable to the Association, a Project OperationalManual (POM) setting out, inter alia, detailed guidelines and procedures for the implementation of the Project, including withrespect to: financial management; procurement; disbursement, system of internal controls, corruption and fraud mitigation measures;and roles and responsibilities for Project implementation.

Mozambique Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I.C.1: The Recipient shall cause INE to, not later than one (1) month after theEffective Date, prepare and adopt, in accordance with terms of reference acceptable to the Association, a Project OperationalManual (“POM”) setting out detailed guidelines, methods and procedures for the implementation of INE's respective part of theProject.

SADC Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I.B.1: The Recipient shall, not later than one hundred and twenty (120) days afterthe Signature Date, prepare and adopt, in accordance with terms of reference acceptable to the Association, a Project OperationalManual (POM) setting out, inter alia, detailed guidelines and procedures for the implementation of the Project, including withrespect to: financial management; procurement; disbursement, system of internal controls, corruption and fraud mitigation measures;and roles and responsibilities for Project implementation.

Zambia Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I.A.1 (a): The Recipient shall cause ZamStats to establish, not later than 120 daysafter Signature Date, and thereafter maintain at all times during the implementation of the Project, a Project Implementation Unitwithin ZamStats with mandate, composition, and resources acceptable to the Association.
